reviewer: Root independent implementation reviewer; execution family authored by os_coverage
scope: Static review of original task/wait state machines, synchronization, bounded scheduling/reclamation models, Cortex-M assembly/port, H745 cold-reset baseline, contracts, unsolved scaffolds, tests and strict image driver. Separate final matrix receipts establish current execution.

findings.summary: Cortex blocking adapters reject handler mode and PRIMASK/BASEPRI/FAULTMASK critical sections before changing wait state; task creation is startup-only; guest guards exercise rejection.
Queue abort discards buffered items and wakes both waiter directions; normal close retains drain semantics; regressions distinguish them.
Withdrawal of the final pending writer re-admits eligible readers; RW-lock regression covers the stranded-reader case.
Contracts disclose externally serialized core operations, raw slot IDs, once RETRY/reentry, half-range deadlines and required idle task.
H745 baseline scope is cold global reset/noncacheable shared SRAM/HSEM; cache/DMA/clock/independent-reset extensions require separate learner implementation and physical evidence.
